content:
maria: quick note — BF launch next week: traffic pattern shifted to EU-edge (cdn changes). we have hotspots in eu-west and sa-east, some nodes are hitting sustained GPU util >85% for long tails. worried about increased latency + queuing. anyone seeing similar?
kevin: saw the same in test replay this morning. queue depth spiked around 09:10 and autoscaler took ~3m to add more pods. throughput per-GPU dropped ~18%.
ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scale up triggered in eu-west-1 (12 -> 48 pods) reason=queue_depth threshold breached at 2026-03-01T09:12:18Z
sunita: likely from the geo routing change + a /preview endpoint that has heavier context sizes. egress near eu-west are also increasing — might hit network QOS on certain hosts.
maria: cost note — if we blindly overscale for BF burst we'll burn a lot of GPU hours. need a 72h projection and plan to cap burst or use cheaper quantized fallback.
rick: +1. can we do a blended-plan: pre-warm minimal headroom, enable cross-region spill to eu-central(us-west backup?) and set a graceful degradation to fp16-quantized model for non-SLAs. that should limit extra GPU hours.
kevin: i ran a quick projection from the replay + expected 4x traffic multiplier. snippet:
```
# projection (24h window)
baseline_gpu_hours: 420
expected_peak_gpu_hours: 1680  # 4x
prewarm_plan_gpu_hours: 520    # small prewarmed pool in eu-west + eu-central
spill_to_other_regions_gpu_hours: 160
quantized_fallback_gpu_hours_savings: ~30%
```
kevin: so naive overscale to meet peak everywhere => ~+1260 gpu-hours. with prewarm + spill + fallback => ~+420 gpu-hours. ~3x savings.
sunita: network QOS: we should check egress caps in eu-west hosts. run: `./tools/net-check --region eu-west-1 --since 24h` to surface hosts with >70% egress. also add rule to avoid routing large-context previews to single gateway.
maria: ops: priority list? 1) run net-check and surface 10 worst hosts (@kevin) 2) create temporary routing rule to spill to eu-central and sa-east if queue_depth > 80% (ops oncall) 3) enable quantized fallback for /preview and non-paid tiers (rick) 4) instrument cost-metering per-route with 1h granularity (sunita)
kevin: on it — running net-check now. found 7 hosts >75% egress, 3 of those also at GPU util >90%. i will tag and cordon the most overloaded ones, then trigger drain to move queued work.
rick: will open rollout PR for quant-fallback flag and add canary at 5% traffic. snippet for rollout config:
```json
{
  "route": "/preview",
  "fallback_model": "redwood-quant-v1",
  "canary": 0.05
}
```
maria: good. ops-bot — please post autoscaler logs to the incident thread and set a reminder at T-12h before launch for final capacity review. :alarm_clock:
ops-bot: Reminder created: "BF-launch capacity final check" scheduled for 1769200000. Logs uploaded to /mnt/logs/autoscaler/eu-west-1/1769123456.log
sunita: one more ask — can security check egress route changes quickly? we'll need approval for cross-region spill due to data residency. @security (separate thread)
maria: noted. for cost tracking i want a quick dashboard showing: per-region gpu-hours, per-route quant-fallback counts, egress GB, and estimated bill if we hit projected peak. can someone pair with finance for a 1-pager?
kevin: i'll grab finance. short action items in thread:
- kevin: net-check + cordon overloaded hosts (ETA 20m)
- rick: open PR for quantized fallback + canary (ETA 1h)
- ops oncall: implement routing spill policy (ETA 40m)
- sunita: add per-route network alerts + notify security for residency (ETA 2h)
maria: thanks. let's keep updates in this thread only. minimal noise. :thumbsup:
kevin: update — net-check results posted, cordoned 3 hosts, draining. autoscaler is stable for now but still higher baseline.
rick: PR created: link=https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/4523 (canary=5%)
sunita: added network alerts to prowling dashboard and pinged security.
maria: closing the loop: if anyone sees latency >250ms on /preview tag me here. otherwise we'll reconvene at scheduled reminder.
